verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy's evidence covers recurring subscription billing (weekly, monthly, yearly charges), automated dunning retries, and webhooks for asynchronous events. These are built-in billing behaviors and event callbacks, not a documented way for users to define and schedule their own recurring jobs or workflows. Recurring billing and dunning are adjacent features and earn no credit, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
